summary: Parked-car kerb, but homes sit 16-17 m behind the best part.
reasons: Gentle grade at the far end

best_section.where: Stanley Terrace north kerb, eastern end past the bend

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 16-17 m from the kerb on the same side; more homes across the road at 20 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with kerbside parking; cars parked along the north kerb near the end.
drivers.convention: No signs; parked cars suggest kerbside parking is normal.

flags: Homes 10-25 m away on own side
Steeper earlier on: max about 11% grade near 30-35 m
Tree canopy hides part of the kerb
sun_shade: Open at the best section; trees shade the middle of the stretch.
